title: Flare analytics treemap
intent: Show the relative sizes of Flare analytics classes as nested, area-proportional rectangles.

ai.create: Create a treemap from Observable's flat Flare name and size fields with leaf area proportional to size, package colors, and in-cell class labels.
ai.maintain: Change the selected Flare subtree while preserving the raw name and size fields, deterministic squarification, stable leaf identity, colors, and label placement.
